items.question: Does Lovart replace our brand guidelines PDF?
items.answer: It operationalizes them. Brand Kit turns palette, typography, and logo rules into living guardrails that generated assets inherit — the PDF becomes reference, not the only enforcement tool.

items.question: Can we show packaging and retail mockups fast?
items.answer: Yes. Generate photorealistic packaging, merch, signage, and environmental scenes from the same identity session for stakeholder review.

items.question: How do we prevent channel drift?
items.answer: Configure Brand Kit once. Marketing, social, and sales assets inherit the same rules; Touch Edit handles seasonal updates inside the system.

items.question: Does this work for sub-brands and partnerships?
items.answer: Yes. Extend parent Brand Kit rules to product lines and co-marketing lockups while keeping hierarchy clear.

items.question: What can I design with Lovart's AI agent?
items.answer: Everything from logos and brand kits to social media graphics, product photos, videos, and marketing campaigns — all from one AI-powered canvas.

items.question: How does the AI design workflow work?
items.answer: Upload your brief, brand assets, or references. Lovart's AI agent analyzes context, generates multiple options, and lets you refine with natural language —
